fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits outgoing people with quick reactions and a strong voice. Treating listener retention as the standard creates a solid foundation for the work.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are outgoing, react quickly, and care about keeping listeners engaged, announcing is one of the most live-performance-focused entry points in audio media.

traits: Communication: deliver clearly

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but knowing only how to replace ordinary glass. Technicians who can calibrate smart glass, provide mobile service, and deliver excellent customer care will continue to attract work.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This career does not suit people who dislike dirty work, lack patience, or cannot stay focused. Removing old glass creates fragments and adhesive residue, and a missed step during replacement can require the entire job to be redone.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path starts with an apprenticeship or an automotive repair program at a vocational school, followed by work as an installation apprentice at a glass chain or repair shop. fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits people who are dexterous, meticulous, and willing to practice. It is a strong fit if you can use tools in tight spaces, insist on an even sealant bead, and enjoy learning the technology used in new vehicles and models.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept a rhythm in which craftsmanship drives your livelihood, income depends on job volume, and every finished job delivers a visible result, this career is worth considering.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Dexterity: use tools confidently in tight spaces
Attention to detail: insist on accurate adhesive beads and gaps
Willingness to learn: quickly master technology in new vehicle models
Tolerance for messy work: adhesive and glass fragments are routine
Service mindset: clearly explain the work to vehicle owners

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept a full day at the winding machine, insulation-varnish odors, and overtime during peak orders, the tangible craftsmanship can make this career worthwhile.

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but safety and the work environment. AI can warn of failures, but technicians must personally handle hot, high-pressure sites, turnaround pressure, and every safety procedure.

fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: complete secondary vocational education in electromechanical systems, machinery, or instrumentation; join a factory equipment-maintenance team; assist with valve disassembly; master sealing, calibration, and testing; earn a fitter or instrument-technician skill certificate; then take independent responsibility for valve repairs and upgrade projects.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits people with dexterity, attention to detail, and curiosity about machinery. If you can spend a morning perfecting one valve's sealing surface and accurately set an actuator from drawings, it can be a strong fit.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy solving mechanical problems and can handle demanding factory maintenance, valve repair offers a durable skilled trade. This guidance supports career exploration only; it is not a diagnosis, hiring decision, or employment guarantee.

traits: Dexterity: precise valve-body disassembly
Attention to detail: exacting seal and calibration work
Safety awareness: never skip isolation procedures
Curiosity: understand how valves work
Endurance: spend a full day at a maintenance site

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你喜欢跟机械设备较劲，又扛得住工厂检修的辛苦，阀门维修是一份越老越吃香的硬手艺。

fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: study art history, museum studies, archaeology, or a related field → work as a Museum or Gallery Intern / Assistant Curator → begin with exhibition installation → plan a small exhibition independently → build a portfolio and lead major or permanent exhibitions.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who are intensely curious, patient with research, and willing to negotiate partnerships. If you can spend three months tracing a painting's provenance and then debate display height with installers, the role could fit you.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you will spend three months tracing one sentence to its source and half a day adjusting one light, curation can offer substantial rewards. This is career-exploration guidance, not a diagnosis, hiring decision, or employment guarantee.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial.
traits: Curiosity: investigate the story behind every object
Aesthetic judgment: recognize quality and explain why

Communication and negotiation: manage loans, sponsors, and teams
